request.prompt:
Deliverable: wide article cover for a Chinese AI engineering blog, readable as a small Feishu/WeChat thumbnail.
Primary request: a sophisticated editorial cover for Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One decision model. The image must make the model name visibly memorable instead of treating it as an abstract unlabeled diagram.
Composition: dark graphite and warm paper editorial workspace. On the left, messy human-language evidence cards and ambiguous fragments flow into a clean central decision line. On the right, three restrained probability gauges and branching software paths suggest typed decisions becoming code. Place one large title in the upper-right: "Jev". Place one smaller subtitle directly below it: "SYSTEM ONE". Place one small brand line below the subtitle: "TypeSafe AI". Keep the text inside a clean dark negative-space panel with strong contrast and generous margins.
Style and medium: premium contemporary editorial technology illustration, tactile paper grain, precise geometric forms, restrained cobalt blue and vermilion accents, intelligent rather than glossy sci-fi.
Lighting and color: soft warm light on paper, deep graphite background, cobalt and vermilion data paths, off-white typography.
Text (exact): Render "Jev" exactly once as the main title, title case, large clean sans-serif. Render "SYSTEM ONE" exactly once below it in smaller uppercase sans-serif. Render "TypeSafe AI" exactly once below that in small title case. No other readable letters, numbers, words, labels, signatures, or logos anywhere in the image.
Avoid: generic glowing brain, robot mascot, cyberpunk neon, stock illustration, tiny invented UI text, misspellings, duplicated titles, watermark.
